verdicts.title: Boolean lattices in finite alternating and symmetric groups
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Given a group $G$ and a subgroup $H$, we let $\mathcal{O}_G(H)$ denote the lattice of subgroups of $G$ containing $H$. This paper provides a classification of the subgroups $H$ of $G$ such that $\mathcal{O}_{G}(H)$ is Boolean of rank at least $3$, when $G$ is a finite alternating or symmetric group. verdicts.title: Quotients and subgroups of Baumslag-Solitar groups
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We determine all generalized Baumslag-Solitar groups (finitely generated groups acting on a tree with all stabilizers infinite cyclic) which are quotients of a given Baumslag-Solitar group BS(m,n), and (when BS(m,n) is not Hopfian) which of them also admit BS(m,n) as a quotient. We determine for which values of r,s one may embed BS(r,s) into a given BS(m,n), and we characterize finitely generated groups which embed into some BS(n,n).
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract concerns quotients and embeddings of Baumslag-Solitar groups acting on trees, with no mention of symmetric groups, CNF formulas, satisfying assignments, or Frege proof depth. It shares only the generic vocabulary of 'quotient' with the conjecture.
